text: 你听见诺曼发出可怕的恐惧哀嚎，顿时感到羞愧：一个如此热衷于求学的人，竟在你的野外考察中遭此下场。
你浑身剧痛、无力反抗，只能继续奔逃。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 356
text: You hear a ghastly wail of fear from Norman and feel a wave of shame that a man so dedicated to his own education should come to this on your field trip.
Wracked and helpless, you race on.
